company.description: Avocademy provides an education platform aimed at training professionals in UX/UI design. Through an eight-week curriculum, the company platform provides consumers with affordable and personalized UX/UI programs, as well as other services such as mentoring, allowing them to build careers in the digital arts field efficiently.
